## Bug fixes

- Native Git checks keep observing their original run when worker acknowledgment or completion
  crosses a status read, instead of aborting the hook while that same check continues.
- Native pre-push can deliberately select its existing bounded check deadline with
  `GOVERNANCE_PRE_PUSH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600 git push`. The default remains 300 seconds; invalid values
  refuse, required tests remain selected, and genuine failures or unknown cleanup remain blocking.

This maintenance release builds on 4.2.2 and leaves dependencies, configuration schema and runtime
stores unchanged. It supports deliberate upgrades from 4.2.1 without adopting the later 4.5 features.
Publication does not upgrade installations or resume a Git operation that already aborted. Existing
terminal receipts remain observable; they do not become a bypass for a subsequent native hook.

Qualification follows the local compiled-package process with focused source, installed package
and independent review evidence. No live provider/device or development-cost benefit is claimed.
